summary: All synthesized findings are mapped to grounded elements with precise bounding boxes. The search input and toggle switch have clear element bounding boxes. Category cards and navigation links are well covered by element boxes. The heading 'Pick a vibe' is also precisely boxed.
coverageNote: Grounded elements provide exact bounding boxes for all findings. Measured geometry candidates supplement some text elements for clarity. No fallback to freehand coordinates was needed. Unresolved findings: 0.

issues.issue: The 'Moods' navigation link highlight is visually unclear as the current page indicator due to a narrow blue background with insufficient color contrast against the black text, reducing readability and user orientation.
issues.fix: Increase the size of the highlight background behind the 'Moods' link to cover the entire clickable area and use a more distinct color or underline to clearly indicate the active page; also improve contrast by using a darker blue background or white text.

issues.issue: Category cards use emojis without accessible text or ARIA labels, making them potentially invisible or unclear to screen reader users; also, these cards lack hover or focus feedback to indicate they are clickable links.
issues.fix: Add appropriate aria-labels or alt text to emojis used in category cards to ensure screen reader users understand their significance; add visual feedback such as hover highlights, underlines, or cursor changes on the category cards to clearly indicate they are clickable links.

issues.issue: The search input field has no visible label or accessible name, relying only on placeholder text that disappears when typing, which may confuse users and cause accessibility issues for screen reader users.
issues.fix: Add a visible label or an accessible aria-label for the search input field to clarify its purpose even when the placeholder is not visible.

issues.issue: The 'Lights' toggle switch uses numeric labels '1' and '0' which are not descriptive and may confuse screen reader users about the toggle state.
issues.fix: Replace numeric labels with descriptive text such as 'On' and 'Off' or use aria-checked attributes to indicate toggle state.
